title: tag_group:makeup
body:
A [[tag groups|tag group]] for [[makeup]]-related tags which are [[cosmetics]] applied to the face.

h4.Types of Makeup

* !post #312600: [[lipstick]]: Changes the color of [[lips]]
* !post #7954592: [[lipgloss]]: Makes [[lips]] glossy
* !post #287200: [[rouge (makeup)]] (also known as "blush"): Gives a redder color to the cheeks
* !post #5891791: [[eyeliner]]: Gives contour to the eyelids
* !post #8893184: [[eyeshadow]]: Gives color to the eyelids
* !post #9519898: [[eyeshadow under eye]]: Eyeshadow on the lower eyelid
* !post #9733554: [[smokey eyeshadow]]: Eyeshadow that is blended to create a smoky gradient effect
* !post #2956997: [[mascara]]: Makes [[eyelashes]] thicker
* !post #9419912: [[highlighter (makeup)|highlighter]]: Usually applied to the nose to make its color lighter
* !post #8054111: [[bronzer]]: Gives a warm or [[tan|tanned]] appearance to the skin
* !post #8426082: [[glitter makeup]]: [[Glitter]] used as makeup
* !post #9441556: [[gyaru makeup]]: Makeup associated with [[gyaru]] culture

h4.Objects and Scenery

* !post #2592834: [[lipstick tube]]: Used to apply [[lipstick]]
* !post #5909469: [[doe-foot applicator]]: Used to apply liquid [[lipstick]], [[lipgloss]] or foundation
* !post #10026125: [[makeup brush]]: Can be of any size, used to apply [[rouge (makeup)|rouge]], [[eyeshadow]] or [[lipstick]]
* !post #10270902: [[makeup sponge]]: Used to apply liquid/cream products like foundation and concealer
* !post #5909482: [[powder puff]]: Used to apply [[rouge (makeup)|rouge]], [[bronzer]] or foundation
* !post #7480882: [[mascara wand]]: Used to apply [[mascara]] to the [[eyelashes]]
* !post #9392989: [[eyelash curler]]: Used to curl [[eyelashes]]
* !post #9182109: [[compact (cosmetics)]]: A portable [[mirror]] that can contain a [[powder puff]]

* !post #8153542: [[makeup palette]]: A palette with various [[rouge (makeup)|rouge]] or [[eyeshadow]] colors
* !post #2569226: [[vanity table]]: A [[table]] with a [[mirror]] where [[cosmetics]] are placed
* !post #6380292: [[dressing room]]: A room for dressing before a performance
* !post #9866484: [[marquee lights]]: The [[lamp|lamps]] on the [[mirror]] of a [[vanity table]]
* !post #9520845: [[exploded cosmetics]]: A composition with various [[cosmetics]] surrounding the character
